This repo isn't a design system the `/design-sync` skill can sync, so I'm stopping before starting the (hours-long, token-heavy) import.

**What I checked:**
- `package.json` — only `prettier` + `@shopify/prettier-plugin-liquid`, no React/component library
- No `.storybook/`, no `*.stories.*` files
- No `dist/` build output
- No existing `.design-sync` config (so it'd be a first-time import)

**Why it doesn't fit:** `/design-sync` converts a **React/web-component design-system repo** — one with a compiled `dist/` of components — into the format claude.ai/design's agent builds with (`window.<globalName>.*` bundle, per-component `.d.ts`/`.prompt.md`, etc.).
